scope: Model-scenario selection by structural features; not empirical validation and not a fit to the WSCG force series.

metric.name: wscg_structural_feature_score
metric.definition: Count of the four documented WSCG model features reproduced by the compiled MjModel. Ties: planar first, then an existing MuJoCo ZTCF/ZVCF test, then fewer DOF.

runner_up.why_it_lost: Scored 2/4 against 3/4: it lacks two_hand_closure and flexible_shaft. With one grip it cannot produce the separate lead- and trail-hand forces the WSCG study reports, although it is planar and already has a MuJoCo ZTCF/ZVCF parity test.

caveats: The selected model is 3D; WSCG is planar, so #14438 must project hand forces onto a declared swing plane.
qpos0 is the compiled reference pose, not a matched address pose.

parameters.controls: zero (ZTCF state); torques are set by #14438

input_data.label: initial condition: compiled qpos0 with zero qvel
